title: Foreigners’ unauthorized installation of giant ball on Vietnam rice terrace draws backlash

title: Vietnam's Nha Trang plans nearly $303mn flood control project

title: Every meal, every drink: How Vietnam’s security officers protect VIPs
snippet: Ensuring the safety of food and drinks served to VIPs in Vietnam involves a strict inspection process, with officers checking ingredients, testing food and beverages using specialized equipment and professional methods, monitoring preparation and serving, and keeping samples afterward.

title: Air pollution exceeds daily limits 1 in 3 days, ranks No. 3 death risk in Vietnam

title: Ho Chi Minh City’s Ben Thanh Market food stall suspended after cockroaches found on food

title: What the Gabrielle Goliath case has meant for SA’s art world
snippet: Minister of Sport, Arts and Culture Gayton McKenzie’s censorship of Gabrielle Goliath’s video-based project Elegy at the Venice Biennale sent shock waves through the art world, and its reverberations are still being felt. title: S. Korea's Park Hye-jeong wins silver in women's weightlifting
snippet: NAGOYA, Japan — South Korea's Park Hye-jeong captured silver in the heaviest weight class in women's weightlifting at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Tuesday. In the women's +81-kilogram event final at Nagoya City Trade Industry Center in Nagoya, Japan, Park finished second with a total of 300 kilograms, with 133kg in the snatch and 167kg in the clean and jerk, behind Li Wenwen of China, who lifted a total of 310kg, with 140kg in the snatch and 170kg in the clean and jerk. Bronze went to Ouisal Ikhlef of Qatar, who recorded a total of 273kg. Park won the gold medal in the event at the previous Hangzhou Asian Games but failed to defend her Asiad title.
